0022600094.text: The Charlotte Hornets (1-0, 3rd in the Southeast, 6th in the East) host the Atlanta Hawks (1-0, 1st in the Southeast, 2nd in the East) in the Hornets' second game of the 2026-27 season, with both teams unbeaten so far. Charlotte is missing Coby White (calf strain), Grant Williams (hamstring), and Kylan Boswell (knee), all out, and Kon Knueppel (hamstring) is day-to-day and a game-time decision, while Atlanta is without Henri Veesaar (knee) and Mouhamed Gueye (foot fracture), both out. Charlotte won the 2025-26 season series 3-1, and its most recent meeting, on February 11, 2026 in Charlotte, ended in a 110-107 Hornets win; the 2026-27 series has no games yet.
